entities.summary: Lawrence Edward "L. J." Collier Jr. is an American professional football defensive end for the Arizona Cardinals of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the TCU Horned Frogs, and was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the first round of the 2019 NFL draft.
